newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after a fairly quiet interbank session on Tuesday, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The Zimbabwe dollar didn't move much from where it opened today which was a bit surprising because the market closed a little on the short side. Probably some banks had a few inflows," one dealer commented.
The local dollar finished the day at Monday's 10.2500/2700 against the U.S. currency and was also quoted unchanged versus the rand at 2.2800/2900.
It lost against sterling to 15.9200/9500 from 15.9100/9600 but edged up on the mark to 6.7700/7900 from 6.7800/8000 previously.
